name: Algomo
summary: AI inbound agent and website personalization for B2B — qualifies visitors by identity, holds contextual conversations and books meetings from your existing traffic.
best_for: B2B teams with real inbound traffic that want an AI agent qualifying visitors, personalizing the site by visitor identity and booking meetings — and don't mind a sales-led buying process
skip_if: you want self-serve, transparent pricing, or you are pre-traffic — an AI inbound agent needs inbound to work with
honest_knock: Algomo is a member of the quote-only club: $200/month is the only number on the site, and the real bill for your traffic volume and feature set only emerges in a sales conversation. Budgeting before the demo is guesswork — and quote-priced tools rarely get cheaper at renewal. Worth knowing before it becomes load-bearing: the personalisation runs from a JavaScript snippet in your header, so the tailored copy and routing rules live for as long as the subscription does. Remove the snippet and every visitor sees the original page again.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-03 on newmode.ai/pricing and the homepage) Plans start at $200 a month with no per-seat pricing - and that single sentence is still the entire public price list, unchanged since our July and August readings and again on 14 September and 3 October 2026. The pricing page carries exactly two plans, Growth and Enterprise, and both buttons say 'Let's chat' and 'Book call': no amount, no contact slider, no self-serve tier. Growth lists 1:1 personalized LinkedIn ads, AI-generated ad copy, website personalization, CRM integration and email support; Enterprise adds unlimited campaigns, custom integrations, a dedicated success manager, priority support and advanced analytics. What drives the price between the two is not published anywhere on the site, so the only figure a buyer can budget against is the $200 floor.

compare_with.name: Intercom
compare_with.why: Intercom's Fin is the incumbent AI-agent route with published pricing; Algomo leads with identity-based personalization and meeting booking, but keeps its price list behind a demo
